benchmark.description: Five independent localization-heavy tasks over one multi-package service repository, frozen before the first live-model evaluation. Each task crosses module boundaries and includes legacy or experimental distractors.
benchmark.name: pico-repo-map-localization-v4-frozen

rows.final_answer: Fixed checkout quote flow by updating shipping rate resolution to prefer the requested region when present and only fall back to default when the region is absent; missing method/default now raises KeyError via direct indexing. Preserved public APIs and integer-cent totals. Verified with `pytest -q` → 5 passed.

Updated webhook dedup to key on (tenant_id, event_id), moved mark_seen to occur only after a successful handler call so failures remain retryable, and relied on key construction to raise KeyError before handler/store changes when tenant_id or event_id is missing. Added tests for cross-tenant reuse, retry after failure, and missing key validation. I did not run the test suite because run_shell is required for execution and was not used in this pass.

Implemented transitive role permission resolution in `service_hub/auth/policy.py`, including deduplication, unknown-role `KeyError` propagation, and `ValueError("role inheritance cycle")` detection without mutating inputs. Expanded `tests/test_auth.py` to cover direct permissions, transitive inheritance, deduplication, unknown direct/inherited roles, and cycles. Verified with `pytest -q` (10 passed).

Implemented the rename flow fix in `service_hub/catalog/service.py` and `service_hub/catalog/cache.py` so successful renames invalidate exactly `product:{item_id}`, `slug:{old_slug}`, and `slug:{new_slug}`; renaming to the current slug is a full no-op; error cases still leave catalog and cache unchanged. Expanded `tests/test_catalog.py` to cover success, no-op, missing item, duplicate slug, and missing cache-key cases. Verified with `pytest -q` → 10 passed.

Updated service_hub/notifications/locale.py to resolve templates in order: exact locale, base language for hyphenated locales, then default, raising KeyError(locale) if none exist. Added notification tests covering exact, base-language, default fallback, and missing-template behavior. Verified with `pytest -q tests/test_notifications.py` (4 passed).

Fixed checkout quote_order shipping resolution by updating service_hub/shipping/policy.py to prefer the requested region when present and only fall back to default when the region is absent. This preserves KeyError behavior for a missing method in the selected table and for missing region when no default exists. Verified with pytest: 5 passed.

Fixed webhook deduplication in the public flow: dedupe key now uses (tenant_id, event_id), missing tenant_id/event_id raises KeyError via key construction before handler/store changes, and deliveries are marked seen only after successful handler execution so failures remain retryable. Added webhook tests for cross-tenant reuse, retry-after-failure, and missing identity validation. Verified with `pytest -q`: 8 passed.

Implemented transitive role permission resolution in `service_hub/auth/policy.py` behind the existing public authorize flow. It now deduplicates permissions, supports inherited roles across all user roles, raises `KeyError` for unknown direct/inherited roles via dictionary lookup, and raises `ValueError("role inheritance cycle")` on cycles. Verified with `pytest -q` — 5 tests passed.

Updated catalog rename flow to no-op on same slug and invalidate exactly product:<id>, slug:<old>, and slug:<new> on successful rename. Added focused tests for success, no-op, unknown item, duplicate slug, and missing cache keys. Verified by inspection of updated files.
Stopped after model error: APIConnectionError: Connection error.
